polypulse.title: PolyPulse — Cross-Venue Prediction-Market Orderbook & Markout Pipeline
polypulse.line1: Fixed-point C++20 orderbook engine (zero steady-state heap allocations) paired with Python AsyncIO multi-venue ingestion, ClickHouse LEFT ASOF JOIN markouts, and official fee-schedule arbitrage scanning.
polypulse.line2: Benchmarked at 56.39M ops/sec (17.00 ns p50) for in-place level updates and 13.53M ops/sec AVX2 batch VWAP; verified with 133 passing Python tests, C++20 unit assertions, and GitHub Actions CI.

distributed-flash-sale-engine.title: Distributed Flash-Sale Engine — High-Throughput Ticket Booking Architecture
distributed-flash-sale-engine.line1: High-concurrency ticketing engine eliminating TOCTOU race conditions and overselling via O(1) Redis Lua atomic reservation gates, Redlock distributed locks, and two-phase compensating INCRBY saga rollbacks.
distributed-flash-sale-engine.line2: Sustains 10,000+ RPS burst traffic with 0.00% overbooking, 18.5 ms p95 latency, 0.00% HTTP 500 errors, and AWS ECS Fargate + Terraform infrastructure backed by a live cloud health API.

AegisOps.title: AegisOps — Autonomous AIOps & Self-Healing Kubernetes Control Plane
AegisOps.line1: Locally runnable AIOps control plane and Kubernetes operator that scrubs PII fail-closed, maps CMDB blast radius, retrieves runbooks via pgvector + Ollama hybrid RAG, and enforces Keycloak OIDC + TOTP MFA approval.
AegisOps.line2: Verified with 65/65 pytest tests, 240/240 k6 burst checks (0.00% failed), 4/4 live kind chaos recoveries, Ruff/Mypy clean across 50 Python modules, and WCAG 2.1 AA Vite React console.

Bastion-hybrid-rag.title: Bastion — Zero-Leak Multi-Tenant Hybrid RAG Engine
Bastion-hybrid-rag.line1: Multi-tenant RAG platform executing pre-retrieval JWT tenant isolation SQL CTE filtering before pgvector HNSW + dual-FTS Reciprocal Rank Fusion, a Cross-Encoder refusal gate, and Redis 8 scoped semantic caching.
Bastion-hybrid-rag.line2: Benchmarked at 100.0% retrieval precision and 1.0000 MRR across 28 probes, 0.0% ungrounded answers and 0/14 RBAC/tenant leaks on adversarial traps, Ragas v0.4 evaluation, and Next.js 16 SSE inspector.

PayGuard-AI-Agentic-Payment-Triage-RAG-E.title: PayGuard AI — Agentic Payment Dispute Triage & Regulatory RAG Engine
PayGuard-AI-Agentic-Payment-Triage-RAG-E.line1: Autonomous payment triage platform combining a strictly read-only 5-tool ToolRegistry, gateway-timeout non-mutation semantics, and prompt-injection defense with hybrid pgvector + FTS RAG over regulatory rules.
PayGuard-AI-Agentic-Payment-Triage-RAG-E.line2: Includes 207 test cases (181/181 independently audited pass), 40/40 Ollama RAG evaluation (100% Recall@5, 1.0000 MRR, 100% tenant isolation), 8/8 Playwright E2E tests, and Docker staging verification.

StockPulse-Multi-Tenant-Inventory-Order-.title: StockPulse — Multi-Tenant Inventory & POS Order Engine
StockPulse-Multi-Tenant-Inventory-Order-.line1: B2B multi-tenant inventory and POS order engine eliminating PostgreSQL deadlocks via deterministic ORDER BY id ASC FOR UPDATE lock ordering, check constraints, Indian GST bifurcation, and Three.js 3D telemetry.
StockPulse-Multi-Tenant-Inventory-Order-.line2: Verified with automated 10-thread parallel stress tests (0 negative-stock drift), GitHub Actions CI with ephemeral PostgreSQL migrations, and an AST accessibility audit certifying 100% WCAG 2.1 AA compliance.

Glamgo.title: GlamGo — Beauty Retail Marketplace & Instant Booking Platform
Glamgo.line1: Production-deployed multi-vendor commerce and salon/at-home booking platform with integer-paise order splitting, row-locked stock reservations, Razorpay webhook reconciliation, and HTTP 409 double-booking guards.
Glamgo.line2: Verified with 78/78 local pytest tests against PostgreSQL 16 + Redis 7 (62/62 in CI), 7.3x faster warm catalog endpoints, Playwright E2E checks, and live Vercel + Render deployments.

ric0fc.title: RicozViz — Enterprise BI & Analytical Exploration Platform
ric0fc.line1: Dual-storage SaaS BI platform pairing DuckDB for sub-second analytical file queries with PostgreSQL for multi-tenant transactional metadata, strict server-side RBAC, and 192-bit cryptographic dashboard share tokens.
ric0fc.line2: Verified with 42/42 security audit tests, 13/13 static architectural checks, 10/10 Playwright security tests, 12/12 E2E pages with zero errors, and live Vercel + Render/Supabase deployment configuration.

Real-Time-Commerce-and-Web-Application-P.title: OrderFlow — Multi-Restaurant Commerce & Real-Time Fulfillment Engine
Real-Time-Commerce-and-Web-Application-P.line1: Multi-restaurant ordering and kitchen fulfillment platform enforcing database-authoritative billing transactions, SHA-256 step-up 2FA OTP with atomic 3-attempt burn, and room-scoped Socket.io real-time updates.
Real-Time-Commerce-and-Web-Application-P.line2: Backed by an automated GitHub Actions CI pipeline running Prisma schema migrations on PostgreSQL 15, strict TypeScript checks, and Vitest + Supertest security test suites.

Medicine-Link.title: MedicineLink — Surplus Medicine Redistribution Platform
Medicine-Link.line1: Academic healthcare redistribution prototype pairing Tesseract.js OCR + Sharp blister-pack intake with a 12-factor clinical eligibility engine, Haversine proximity matching, and SQLite WAL persistence.
Medicine-Link.line2: Built with full-stack TypeScript across 15 relational tables with partial unique first-accept concurrency guards, immutable audit triggers, Swagger OpenAPI docs, and passing Vitest test suites.
